items.description: Shows a generated modeling diagram through the diagram editor canvas. The public InsertAtViewportCenterAsync(element) is the non-drag path (Fáze 6, WCAG 2.5.7): it creates the node at the CENTER OF THE VIEWPORT through the embedded editor's GetViewport() (the page center while no viewport is known — SSR, prerender, bUnit) via the same clamp/collision logic and the same OnNodeDropped contract the drop uses; AllowNodeDrop switches both paths.

items.description: Loads a semantic modeling source and presents a modeling editor workspace. On the docked layouts (tablet/desktop, resolved from the editor's own container) the workspace renders through the core TmEditorShell. On the TABLET band (768-1199 of container) the shell presents its TabletPanelPresentation.Overlay: the model tree is an overlay drawer, the inspector a non-modal side sheet, at most ONE open at a time, and the "Panels" tab row (the same test ids as the compact row) acts as the visibility switch (aria-expanded toggles; Preview closes both). A tree selection opens the inspector sheet, and the tree's "Insert into preview" action (WCAG 2.5.7 non-drag alternative to dragging) reuses the element through the preview's existing drop path at the viewport center — TmModelingDiagramPreview.InsertAtViewportCenterAsync — honoring AllowNodeDrop. On the docked layouts (tablet/desktop, resolved from the editor's own container) the workspace renders through the core TmEditorShell: Header (title, state badge, the provider/notation/viewpoint group), Left (model tree), Canvas (diagram preview with the collapsible Issues dock under it — header with a neutral count, aria-expanded toggle, the collapsed state is session-owned), Right (inspector with Properties | Source tabs — only the active tab renders its body, a stale source marks the Source tab with a neutral indicator and the tab drives the editor's reload) and StatusBar. The layout thresholds are the DiagramEditor pair (mobile below 768px of container, tablet 768-1199, desktop from 1200); below the editor's own mobile threshold the pre-redesign compact workspace (panel tabs, one visible panel) renders until the mobile phase. The docked shell is not pinned to the editor's resolved mode: an Auto shell measures its own container, so the nested TmDiagramEditors (preview + open-editor dialog) resolve from their own containers. The preview's "Open in editor" action opens the generated document in a core TmModal viewport dialog (scrim, TmFocusScope focus trap, Escape) sized ~90vw x 90vh on the desktop AND the tablet band (the near-fullscreen footprint keys off the editor container, not the viewport); the dialog header owns the document title (falling back to the "Open in editor" label) and the close button, and the embedded TmDiagramEditor keeps every panel with ToolbarPreset=Full and ShowTitle=false (one header). Changes keep propagating live to the preview (G8), so the scrim is not a close affordance.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: Whether model tree elements can be reused by dropping them onto the preview canvas.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the editor root.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The editor's block size (a CSS length only - e.g. 600px, 100%, 100dvh). Null keeps the stylesheet contract min(768px, 100vh - 32px) (the token pair on .tm-modeling-editor). When set, the editor renders exactly this height (the token min-height floor is dropped with an inline min-height: 0) - the host owns the sizing. The shell inside fills the box.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The mode rendered before the first measurement of an Auto editor (SSR, prerender and the first frame). Desktop markup degrades acceptably through the data-layout CSS.

parameters.name: LayoutBreakpoints
parameters.description: Per-instance thresholds for the editor's own container. Null keeps the Modeling pair (mobile below 768px of container, tablet 768-1199, desktop from 1200 - the same pair as TmDiagramEditor). Only the markup branch moves; stylesheets keep the shared literals.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the editor resolves its presentation. Auto (default) measures the editor's own container with the shared observer (mobile below 768px of container, tablet 768-1199, desktop from 1200 - the same pair as TmDiagramEditor, so hosts embedding both flip them together); a forced mode renders that layout without any measurement so tests and hosts can pin it. The docked layouts render through the core TmEditorShell - an Auto shell measures its own container, so the nested TmDiagramEditors (preview + open-editor dialog) resolve from their own containers; the compact layout keeps the panel-tab workspace.

parameters.name: PersistKey
parameters.description: Overrides the localStorage key the docked shell persists user-resized panel widths under. Null (default) derives the key from TestIdPrefix - {TestIdPrefix}-modeling-editor, or plain modeling-editor without a prefix - so two editors on one page share persisted widths only when they share the prefix. Set it explicitly to namespace (or intentionally share) the saved layout per instance.

parameters.name: ProviderDisplayName
parameters.description: Optional display-name resolver for the provider options and the provider chip (review fix, phase 3). Receives the raw provider key and returns the text to show; when the callback is null (or returns nothing) the raw key itself is shown. The demo maps the keys to localized names; a host may resolve them from its own registry.

parameters.name: ProviderKey
parameters.description: Provider key used to select the semantic model provider. Null or empty values render the empty state.

parameters.name: ProviderKeyChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user picks a provider in the header selector; enables @bind-ProviderKey. The editor reloads the model with the selected provider.

parameters.name: ShowProviderSelector
parameters.description: Renders a labeled "Provider" select in the editor header that lists every registered IModelingModelProvider (MO3). Default false keeps the pre-selector behavior: the provider stays a labeled value chip and remains host-owned through ProviderKey.

parameters.name: ViewpointKey
parameters.description: Optional viewpoint key passed to the selected provider and used to choose the initial model view.

items.description: Displays validation and generation issues for a modeling document. MO1 places it as the collapsible dock under the preview: the header carries the neutral count-only badge and the collapse toggle (aria-expanded + aria-controls); a collapsed panel renders the header only. The dock height belongs to the host's grid row (the panel's own min/max-height pair is gone), and the two-way Collapsed state is the session's.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel root.

parameters.name: Collapsed
parameters.description: Whether the panel body (the issue list or the empty state) is collapsed to the header. Two-way bindable - the host owns the dock height around the collapsed/expanded row. Default false (expanded); the state is the session's and survives re-renders.

parameters.name: CollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user toggles the panel through the header button; enables @bind-Collapsed.

parameters.name: Issues
parameters.description: Issues to render, in input order. Severity only colors the rows — the panel never re-sorts the list (severity filtering/sorting is backlog). Issues without a SourceElementId/SourceRelationshipId render as non-interactive list items; navigable issues render as buttons.

items.description: Displays semantic modeling elements grouped by type with live filtering and selection. Each node row also carries the non-drag "Insert into preview" action (Fáze 6): a sibling button using the core tm-reveal-on-hover contract (hidden until hover on a fine pointer only, always visible on coarse pointers and keyboard focus) that asks the host to reuse the element through the preview's existing drop path at the CENTER of the diagram viewport. The action names its row ("Insert {0} into preview"), stays out of the tab order (tabindex=-1) — the keyboard path is the node treeitem's Insert / Ctrl+Enter (aria-keyshortcuts) — and renders only when AllowNodeDrop is set AND a listener is bound to OnInsertIntoPreview. FilterText/FilterTextChanged optionally two-way bind the live filter so the hosting editor can own the value across tree remounts.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: Whether the tree offers the non-drag "Insert into preview" action (Fáze 6, WCAG 2.5.7). Default true mirrors the hosting editor's AllowNodeDrop: when the host opts out of tree reuse the action disappears with the drop zone, so no alternative path offers what the drop zone refuses.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the tree root.

parameters.name: CollapsedGroups
parameters.description: Optional two-way binding of the collapsed group keys. Seeded from when the instance is given a new collection; every user toggle raises CollapsedGroupsChanged with a fresh snapshot. The parameter is NEVER assigned inside the component.

parameters.name: CollapsedGroupsChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user collapses or expands a group (not while a filter drives the transient state).

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements rendered by the tree. They are grouped by SemanticType.

parameters.name: FilterText
parameters.description: Optional two-way binding of the live filter text (Fáze 6 review fix). The parameter SEEDS the internal filter whenever the host hands over a new value and is never assigned inside the component — user edits update the working copy, clear the transient filter-collapse set and raise FilterTextChanged. The hosting editor owns the field, so the filter survives a tree remount (a layout flip).

parameters.name: FilterTextChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user edits the filter input (not when the host re-seeds the parameter), enabling @bind-FilterText.

parameters.name: OnElementDragEnded
parameters.description: Raised when the user ends a drag operation from a tree node.

parameters.name: OnElementDragStarted
parameters.description: Raised when the user starts dragging an element node. Reserved for canvas drop support.

parameters.name: OnElementSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an element node.

parameters.name: OnInsertIntoPreview
parameters.description: Raised when the user activates the row-level "Insert into preview" action. The HOST computes the drop geometry (the tree knows nothing about the document or its viewport): the hosting editor routes the request through the preview's existing drop path at the viewport center. Keyboard- and touch-reachable by construction (a native button beside the node treeitem, revealed on (hover: none) and :focus-within).

parameters.description: Raised when <see cref="SelectedElement"/> changes.
